siblings.javadoc: /** * Get the Root Mean Square value. * Get the Root Mean Square value, i.e. the root of the arithmetic * mean of the square of all weighted residuals. This is related to the * criterion that is minimized by the estimator as follows: if * c if the criterion, and n is the number of * measurements, then the RMS is sqrt (c/n). * * @param problem estimation problem * @return RMS value */
siblings.name: getRMS

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Get the Chi-Square value.
     * @param problem estimation problem
     * @return chi-square value
     */
siblings.name: getChiSquare

siblings.javadoc:
/** * Guess the errors in unbound estimated parameters. *

Guessing is covariance-based, it only gives rough order of magnitude.

* @param problem estimation problem * @return errors in estimated parameters * @exception EstimationException if the covariances matrix cannot be computed * or the number of degrees of freedom is not positive (number of measurements * lesser or equal to number of parameters) */
siblings.name: guessParametersErrors

siblings.javadoc:
/** * Initialization of the common parts of the estimation. *

This method must be called at the start * of the {@link #estimate(EstimationProblem) estimate} * method.

* @param problem estimation problem to solve */
siblings.name: initializeEstimate

siblings.javadoc:
/** * Solve an estimation problem. * *

The method should set the parameters of the problem to several * trial values until it reaches convergence. If this method returns * normally (i.e. without throwing an exception), then the best * estimate of the parameters can be retrieved from the problem * itself, through the {@link EstimationProblem#getAllParameters * EstimationProblem.getAllParameters} method.

* * @param problem estimation problem to solve * @exception EstimationException if the problem cannot be solved * */
siblings.name: estimate

sig.class_declaration: public abstract class AbstractEstimator implements Estimator
sig.focal_signature: public double[][] getCovariances(EstimationProblem problem) throws EstimationException
methods: public double[] guessParametersErrors(EstimationProblem problem) throws EstimationException;
public abstract void estimate(EstimationProblem problem) throws EstimationException;
type_signatures: public interface EstimationProblem { public WeightedMeasurement[] getMeasurements(); public EstimatedParameter[] getUnboundParameters(); public EstimatedParameter[] getAllParameters(); }
